verdict.rationale: Kit's own docs describe the Kit MCP as a remote MCP server that exposes a creator's account (subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments) to MCP-compatible AI clients with read/write access. A separate Developer Docs MCP server gives coding agents live access to the API reference, and a probe confirms the MCP docs exist. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, documented connection/auth setup details for the Kit MCP in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Kit MCP is a remote MCP server that exposes a creator's Kit account — subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments, and more — to MCP-compatible AI clients.
the Kit MCP gives an AI client the ability to read and write live account data on the creator's behalf.
The Kit Developer Docs MCP (Model Context Protocol) server gives AI coding agents direct, real-time access to Kit's developer documentation.
Natural-language prompts like “draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week” become real account actions.
